subject: english
question:
**Change the following from active to passive:**

They have been neglecting maintenance of the archives for years.

options.text: Maintenance of the archives had been neglected by them for years.
Maintenance of the archives is being neglected by them for years.
Maintenance of the archives was being neglected by them for years.
Maintenance of the archives has been being neglected by them for years.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In this case, the active voice sentence is: "They have been neglecting maintenance of the archives for years."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "maintenance of the archives" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have been neglecting" to "has been being neglected" (present perfect continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "for years" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Maintenance of the archives has been being neglected by them for years."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Maintenance of the archives had been neglected by them for years." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"Maintenance of the archives is being neglected by them for years." – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"Maintenance of the archives was being neglected by them for years." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
